overview: A single Go backend service exposes a minimal REST API for managing todos, backed by embedded persistent storage (SQLite via file) to survive restarts. Clients communicate over HTTP/JSON, and the service provides a health endpoint plus standard request logging.
requirements: Provide GET /todos returning all todos as JSON array with 200
Provide POST /todos to create a todo; validate non-empty title; return 201 with created todo or 400 on invalid input
Provide DELETE /todos/{id} returning 204 on success or 404 if not found
Each todo has unique id, title, optional description, completed (default false), createdAt timestamp
Persist todos to durable storage that survives restarts
Return 400 for malformed JSON, 404 for unknown paths, 405 for unsupported methods, 500 for unexpected errors without leaking details
Consistent JSON error response structure with message
Log each request with method, path, status
Handle concurrent requests safely; respond under 500ms under normal load

components.name: todo-api
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: {type: string}
  /todos:
    get:
      summary: List todos
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'}
    post:
      summary: Create todo
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/TodoCreate'}
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'}
        '400':
          description: Bad Request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
  /todos/{id}:
    delete:
      summary: Delete todo
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '204': {description: No Content}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
components:
  schemas:
    Todo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: {type: string}
        title: {type: string}
        description: {type: string}
        completed: {type: boolean}
        createdAt: {type: string, format: date-time}
    TodoCreate:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title: {type: string}
        description: {type: string}
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        error: {type: string}
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a Go service using net/http on port 9090. Routes: GET /health -> {"status":"ok"}; GET /todos -> JSON array (empty array if none); POST /todos with JSON {title, description?} - reject empty/missing title with 400 {error:...}; reject malformed JSON with 400; on success assign UUID id, createdAt=time.Now().UTC(), completed=false, return 201 with todo JSON. DELETE /todos/{id} -> 204 if deleted, 404 {error:...} if not found. Unknown paths -> 404 JSON error. Unsupported methods on valid paths -> 405 JSON error. Panics/errors -> 500 with generic message. Use SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite, pure Go, no CGo) with file path from env TODO_DB_PATH defaulting to /data/todos.db; create table if not exists. Use sync-safe DB access. Add middleware logging method, path, status, duration. Use UUID (github.com/google/uuid). Dockerfile: multi-stage build, final distroless or alpine, EXPOSE 9090, create /data directory. Ensure graceful shutdown on SIGTERM.
